class Box {
    value: Int

    init(value: Int) {
        self.value = value
    }
}

let evaluated = __eval__('20 + 22')
let spread = (1, *[2, 3])
let box = Box(7)
let dynamic-field = box.{'value'}
let convert = __eval__('str')
let converted = convert(evaluated)
let same = evaluated == 42

print(evaluated, spread, dynamic-field, converted, same)
